description:
Check whether a phone number is ready to send a message or place a call BEFORE you try, so you can fix predictable failures first. Verifies the number is active, assigned to an agent, and capable of the channel you intend, plus the account's A2P/10DLC registration (for US SMS). Optionally checks a recipient's reachability. Returns a ready flag with specific blockers, warnings, and next steps.

Note: credit balance and concurrency limits are enforced by the server at send time and cannot be pre-checked here, so a ready result does not guarantee against an insufficient-credit or busy error.

channel.description: The action you intend, so readiness reflects the right capability. Omit for a general check (active + assigned).

number_id.description: The number to check, from list_numbers.

to_number.description: Optional recipient (E.164) to also check for reachability on the intended channel.

name: check_readiness

outputSchema.description: Whether a number is ready to send/call, with blockers, warnings, and next steps.

assigned.description: Whether the number is attached to an agent.

blockers.description: Hard issues that will cause the action to fail until fixed.

outboundSms.description: Outbound SMS state: enabled, activating, or registration_required.

compliance.description: Account A2P/10DLC registration status; null when SMS isn't relevant or it couldn't be read.

nextSteps.description: Specific actions to resolve the blockers/warnings above.

notChecked.description: Readiness dimensions enforced at send time and not pre-checkable here (credit, concurrency).

ready.description: True when there are no blockers for the intended action.

recipient.description: Recipient reachability, present only when to_number was supplied on a messaging channel.

phoneNumber.description: The recipient number that was checked.

warnings.description: Soft issues that may cause failures.

title: Check Send/Call Readiness
